newsitem.title: USA: Woolworth buys footwear marketer Eastbay Inc.
newsitem.headline: Woolworth buys footwear marketer Eastbay Inc.

text.p: Woolworth Corp said Monday that it has agreed to acquire Eastbay Inc, a direct marketer of athletic footwear, clothing, equipment and licensed and private label products for $24 per share or about $146 million.
Woolworth said it would pay $24 per share cash to all Eastbay shareholders except three senior Eastbay executives and principle shareholders, who would receive $22 per share.
The executives would get another $1.75 per share if certain post-closing performance targets were achieved, Woolworth said.
Woolworth said the acquisition should be completed in early 1997 and it expects Eastbay to be a net contributor to its fiscal 1997 earnings.
Eastbay's management would remain with the company, which would operate as part of Woolworth's Athletic Group, Woolworth said.
Woolworth said its Athletic Group has 3,500 stores worldwide.

"We are excited about the potential for enhancing shareholder value by combining Eastbay's expertise in direct marketing with our strength in selling athletic products through our traditional retailing formats, including Foot Locker and Champs Sports," Woolworth Chairman and Chief Executive Roger Farah said in a release.
The deal has been approved by both companies' boards and remains subject to Eastbay shareholder approval, Woolworth said.
Woolworth shares closed Friday at 24. Eastbay shares closed Friday at 19.
